insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address of an unfulfilled order is updated. This change affects how taxes are handled for orders with changed shipping addresses. The recalculation occurs against the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating order shipping addresses through the orderUpdate mutation. They should test their applications to ensure they handle the tax recalculation correctly. This change may require updates to custom tax calculation logic or integrations with third-party tax services. The orderUpdate mutation in the GraphQL Admin API is affected.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses, which can impact their revenue and compliance with tax laws.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures compliance with tax laws, which is crucial for merchants. It also simplifies the process of handling tax changes due to shipping address updates.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront functionality and development tools

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support is added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with the storefront. This update also includes the ability to update cart attributes and fire events when attributes are updated.

themes.title: Development Tools and Hydrogen
themes.detail: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores. Additionally, the CLI has been updated to serve UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enabling more flexible order management. This update allows developers to attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders using the GraphQL Admin API.
